name: Asuka o Haramase Shuudan Rape!
original_name: アスカを孕ませ集団レイプ!
source:
A visual novel about Asuka from Ev*ngelion.

In the another world where all angels have disappeared. Pilots including Shinji had lost the ability to control EV*s. One day, Asuka came to see Shinji for the first time in several years although they both worked for NERV. And Asuka invited him to her bed. As the lust demanded, Shinji had sex with her lost his virgin. They had sex every night until Asuka becomes pregnant...

translation:
《新世纪福音战士》中关于明日香的视觉小说。

在所有天使都消失的异世界。包括真司在内的飞行员失去了控制电动汽车的能力。有一天，明日香几年来第一次见到真嗣，尽管他们都在NERV工作。明日香邀请他到她的床上。正如欲望的要求，真嗣与失去处女的她发生了性关系。他们每天晚上都做爱，直到明日香怀孕……
